headline: Updates on park projects, including Balch Playground, Holcroft Park splashpad, and Gillis Park pavilion entrance.
summary: Staff reports cover classes, events, and budgets. Community Preservation Committee items include Round 13 and Round 14 applications, plus ongoing work on AEDs and court signage.
items: Assistant director's report on past months and upcoming classes and events
Director's report on events, correspondence, budgets, and field updates
Balch Playground Phase 2, funded by Cummings donation
Gillis Park pavilion and entrance, $200K earmark
Round 13 applications for Ahearn Park, Bartlett Gardens, and Gillis Basketball: equipment orders and court replacement bids
Round 14 applications for Obear Park, Cooney Field, and McPherson Youth Center
Other projects: Abbott St. ROW and Independence Park (out of cycle CPC)
Ongoing projects: AEDs, Beverly in Bloom, Lynch Park resiliency, pickleball and tennis court signage, and other park repairs
Reports from Beverly Golf and Tennis Commission, Community Preservation Committee, and Open Space and Recreation Committee
location: Beverly Depot Restaurant, 10 Park Street, Beverly
